# Hermes Agent Archive — a public, hand-reviewed catalogue of Hermes Agent craft.
# Crawling and indexing are welcome.

User-agent: *
Allow: /

# The maintenance scripts, research inputs and plugin installer are not deployed at all;
# .vercelignore allowlists what ships, so there is nothing here to disallow.

Host: hermes-agent-archive.vercel.app

Sitemap: https://hermes-agent-archive.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

# Every entry now has a static page at /entry/<id> and every shelf one at /shelf/<id>,
# generated by scripts/build-pages.mjs from the same data the app renders. Before those
# existed this was one page with hash routes, a crawler discarded everything after the
# '#', and there was nothing a sitemap could honestly list.
